ops.title: agent_inject fires on every PreToolUse for every agent to drain an almost-always-empty queue
ops.description: capt-hook/hooks/agent_plane.py:20 is @on(Event.PreToolUse) with no only_if. Directives are rare; spawning a process per tool call to drain an empty queue is the wrong shape. Gate on an os.stat of the daemon socket, or a per-session liveness marker written by agent-start. Compounds with caching daemon-absence.

ops.text: agent_plane.py:20 gated on daemon socket existence (os.stat) or a session liveness marker
with no daemon running the hook costs one stat and zero execs
